Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > On-network disposition notifications > Controlling MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receipt of a: "SIP MESSAGE request for SDS disposition notification for MCData server"; or "SIP MESSAGE request for FD disposition notification for MCData server"; the controlling MCData function: if unable to process the request due to a lack of resources or a risk of congestion exists, may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response. The controlling MCData function may include a Retry-After header field to the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response as specified in IETF RFC 3261 . Otherwise, continue with the rest of the steps; shall reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not process the remaining steps if an Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" or "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd"; if the incoming SIP MESSAGE request does not contain an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body or contains an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body with more than one entry element in the set of list elements in the resource-lists element, shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response including warning text set to "145 unable to determine called party" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.9, and shall not continue with the rest of the steps; shall attempt to correlate the disposition notification to the original SDS or FD request using the values contained in the Conversation ID and Message ID of the SDS NOTIFICATION message or FD NOTIFICATION message contained in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body of the SIP MESSAGE; if unable to correlate the disposition notification as determined by step 4), shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response including warning text set to "216 unable to correlate the disposition notification" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.9, and shall not continue with the rest of the steps; if: [ a) ] a "SIP MESSAGE request for FD disposition notification for MCData server" has been received; the FD disposition notification type IE in the FD NOTIFICATION message is set to "FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST REJECTED"; and the SIP MESSAGE does not contain an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with an mcdata-calling-group-id element, or the SIP MESSAGE contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with an mcdata-calling-group-id element and all other FD disposition notifications have been received from the invited group members and were all set to "FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST REJECTED"; then: [ a) ] shall delete the file stored in the media storage function that is associated with the Conversation ID and Message ID that was included in the FD NOTIFICATION message if no other file availability timers are running for a file; and shall stop the running timer TDC2 (file availability timer), which is associated to the Conversation ID, Message ID, Application ID (if associated), and Extended application ID (if associated) that is included in the FD NOTIFICATION message; shall generate a SIP MESSAGE request in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 3428 ; if sending an SDS disposition notification: [ a) ] shall include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcdata.sds media feature tag along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters according to IETF RFC 3841 in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; and shall include an Accept-Contact header field with the media feature tag g.3gpp.icsi-ref with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" along with parameters "require" and "explicit" according to IETF RFC 3841 ] in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; if sending an FD disposition notification: [ a) ] shall include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcdata.fd media feature tag along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters according to IETF RFC 3841 ; and shall include an Accept-Contact header field with the media feature tag g.3gpp.icsi-ref with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" along with parameters "require" and "explicit" according to IETF RFC 3841 ; shall set the Request-URI to the public service identity of the terminating participating MCData function associated to the MCData user to be invited; [NOTE 1:]The public service identity can identify the terminating participating MCData function in the local MCData system or in an interconnected MCData system. [NOTE 2:]If the terminating participating MCData function is in an interconnected MCData system in a different trust domain, then the public service identity can identify the MCData gateway server that acts as an entry point in the interconnected MCData system from the local MCData system. [NOTE 3:]If the terminating participating MCData function is in an interconnected MCData system in a different trust domain, then the local MCData system can route the SIP request through an MCData gateway server that acts as an exit point from the local MCData system to the interconnected MCData system. [NOTE 4:]How the controlling MCData function determines the public service identity of the terminating participating MCData function serving the target MCData ID or of the MCData gateway server in the interconnected MCData system is out of the scope of the present document. [NOTE 5:]How the local MCData system routes the SIP request through an exit MCData gateway server is out of the scope of the present document. if sending an SDS disposition notification, shall include a P-Asserted-Service header field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds"; if sending an FD disposition notification, shall include a P-Asserted-Service header field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd"; shall include a P-Asserted-Identity header field in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request set to the public service identity of the controlling MCData function; shall copy the MCData ID of the MCData user listed in the MIME resources body of the incoming SIP MESSAGE request, into the mcdata-request-uri element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; if the incoming SIP MESSAGE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with an mcdata-calling-group-id element: [ a) ] shall retrieve the group document for the MCData group id contained in the mcdata-calling-group-id element from the group management server, if not already cached, and identify the group members; shall verify that the MCData ID contained in the mcdata-calling-user-id element matches to a group member. If there is no match, the controlling MCData function shall reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response including warning text set to "116 user is not part of the MCData group" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.9, and shall not continue with the rest of the steps; if MCData disposition notifications need to be aggregated and an aggregated disposition notification has not yet been sent: [ i) ] if timer TDC1 (disposition aggregation timer) is not running, shall start timer TDC1 (disposition aggregation timer) with the timer value as specified in clause F.2.2; shall copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body in the received SIP MESSAGE request to the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; NOTE 6: If the aggregated MCData disposition notifications do not fit into one SIP MESSAGE request, then the controlling MCData function needs to generate a new SIP MESSAGE request for the remaining disposition notifications. [] [ i) ] on expiry of timer TDC1 (disposition aggregation timer) shall continue with step 16; and if all MCData disposition notifications have been received from all group members shall continue with step 16; and if MCData disposition notifications do not need to be aggregated, shall copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body in the received SIP MESSAGE request to the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request and shall continue with step 16; if the incoming SIP MESSAGE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body without an mcdata-calling-group-id element shall copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body in the received SIP MESSAGE request to the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; shall send the SIP MESSAGE request according to according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall generate a SIP 202 (Accepted) response in response to the "SIP MESSAGE request for SDS disposition notification for MCData server"; or "SIP MESSAGE request for FD disposition notification for MCData server"; and shall send the SIP 202 (Accepted) response towards the originating participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 .
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Off-network dispositions > Sending off-network SDS delivery notification
Content: To send an off-network SDS delivery notification, the MCData client: shall store "DELIVERED" as the disposition type; shall generate a SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message as specified in clause 15.1.8. In the SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message, the MCData client: [ a) ] shall set the Sender MCData user ID IE to its own MCData user ID as specified in clause 15.2.15; shall set the Conversation ID IE as the stored conversation ID as specified in clause 15.2.9; shall set the Message ID IE as the stored SDS message ID as specified in clause 15.2.10; shall set the Date and time IE as the stored SDS notification time as specified in clause 15.2.8; shall set the SDS disposition notification type IE to the stored disposition type as specified in clause 15.2.5; and may set: [ i) ] the Application ID IE to the stored SDS application ID as specified in clause 15.2.7; or the Extended application ID IE to the stored extended SDS application ID as specified in clause 15.2.24; shall send the SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message to the stored notification target MCData user ID as specified in clause 9.3.1.1; shall initialise the counter CFS2 (SDS notification retransmission) with the value set to 1; and shall start timer TFS2 (SDS notification retransmission).
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Off-network dispositions > Sending off-network SDS read notification
Content: Upon receiving a display indication for the payload to the user or processing of the payload by the target application, the MCData client: shall store "READ" as the disposition type; shall store the current UTC time as the stored SDS notification time; shall generate SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message as specified in clause 15.1.8. In the SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message, the MCData client: [ a) ] shall set the Sender MCData user ID IE to its own MCData user ID as specified in clause 15.2.15; shall set the Conversation ID IE as the stored conversation ID as specified in clause 15.2.9; shall set the Message ID IE as the stored SDS message ID as specified in clause 15.2.10; shall set the Data and time IE as the SDS notification time as specified in clause 15.2.8; shall set the SDS disposition notification type IE to the stored disposition type as specified in clause 15.2.5; and may set: [ i) ] the Application ID IE set to the stored SDS application ID as specified in clause 15.2.7; or the Extended application ID IE to the stored extended SDS application ID as specified in clause 15.2.24; shall send the SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message to the stored sender MCData user ID as specified in clause 9.3.1.1; shall initialise the counter CFS2 (SDS notification retransmission) with the value set to 1; and shall start timer TFS2 (SDS notification retransmission).
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Off-network dispositions > Sending off-network SDS delivered and read notification
Content: Upon receiving a display indication for the payload to the user or processing of the payload by the target application, the MCData client: shall store "DELIVERED AND READ" as the disposition type and stop the timer TFS3 (display and read); shall store the current UTC time as the stored SDS notification time; shall generate SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message. In the SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message, the MCData client: [ a) ] shall set the Sender MCData user ID IE to its own MCData user ID as specified in clause 15.2.15; shall set the Conversation ID IE as the stored conversation ID as specified in clause 15.2.9; shall set the Message ID IE as the stored SDS message ID as specified in clause 15.2.10; shall set the Date and time IE as the SDS notification time as specified in clause 15.2.8; shall set the SDS disposition notification type IE to the stored disposition type as specified in clause 15.2.5; and may set: [ i) ] the Application ID IE to the stored SDS application ID as specified in clause 15.2.7; or the Extended application ID IE to the stored extended SDS application ID as specified in clause 15.2.24; shall send the SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message to the stored sender MCData user ID as specified in clause 9.3.1.1; shall initialise the counter CFS2 (SDS notification retransmission) with the value set to 1; and shall start timer TFS2 (SDS notification retransmission).
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Off-network dispositions > Off-network SDS notification retransmission
Content: Upon expiry of timer TFS2 (SDS notification retransmission), the MCData client: shall generate a SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message as specified in clause 15.1.8. In the SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message, the MCData client: [ a) ] shall set the Sender MCData user ID IE to its own MCData user ID as specified in clause 15.2.15; shall set the Conversation ID IE as the stored conversation ID as specified in clause 15.2.9; shall set the Message ID IE as the stored SDS message ID as specified in clause 15.2.10; shall set the Date and time IE as the stored SDS notification time as specified in clause 15.2.8; shall set the SDS disposition type IE to the stored disposition type as specified in clause 15.2.5; and may set: [ i) ] the Application ID IE to the stored SDS application ID as specified in clause 15.2.7; or the Extended application ID IE to the stored extended SDS application ID as specified in clause 15.2.24; shall send the SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message to the stored sender MCData user ID as specified in clause 9.3.1.1; shall increment the counter CFS2 (SDS notification retransmission) by 1; and shall start timer TFS2 (SDS notification retransmission) if the associated counter CFS2 (SDS notification retransmission) has not reached its upper limit.
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Network-triggered notifications for FD > General > File availability expiry
Content: When the controlling MCData function receives a "SIP MESSAGE request for FD using HTTP for controlling MCData function" (referred to as FD request), it starts a timer TDC2 (file availability timer). The timer value is derived from the "file availability" information contained in metadata in the FD request (if included) or by local policy. The timer running for the file is uniquely associated to the Conversation ID and Message ID in the FD request. The controlling MCData function tracks which MCData client(s) have downloaded the file referenced by the file URL received in an FD request which is associated to a Conversation ID and Message ID. On expiry of timer TDC2 (file availability timer), the controlling MCData function sends a FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message with a notification type set to "FILE EXPIRED UNAVAILABLE TO DOWNLOAD". The MCData client is notified that the file associated with the Conversation ID and Message ID is no longer available to download.
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Network-triggered notifications for FD > Controlling MCData function procedures > Generation of a SIP MESSAGE request for notification
Content: This clause is referenced from other procedures and is not run standalone. The controlling MCData function shall generate a SIP MESSAGE request in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 3428 ; shall include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcdata.fd media feature tag along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters according to IETF RFC 3841 in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; shall include an Accept-Contact header field with the media feature tag g.3gpp.icsi-ref with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" along with parameters "require" and "explicit" according to IETF RFC 3841 in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; shall follow the rules specified in clause 6.4 for the handling of MIME bodies in a SIP message when processing the remaining steps in this clause; shall include in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request: the mcdata-request-uri element set to the MCData ID of the MCData user; and the request-type element set to a value of "notify"; shall set the Request-URI to the public service identity of the terminating participating MCData function associated to the MCData user to be invited; [NOTE 1:]The public service identity can identify the terminating participating MCData function in the local MCData system or in an interconnected MCData system. [NOTE 2:]If the terminating participating MCData function is in an interconnected MCData system in a different trust domain, then the public service identity can identify the MCData gateway server that acts as an entry point in the interconnected MCData system from the local MCData system. [NOTE 3:]If the terminating participating MCData function is in an interconnected MCData system in a different trust domain, then the local MCData system can route the SIP request through an MCData gateway server that acts as an exit point from the local MCData system to the interconnected MCData system. [NOTE 4:]How the controlling MCData function determines the public service identity of the terminating participating MCData function serving the target MCData ID or of the MCData gateway server in the interconnected MCData system is out of the scope of the present document. [NOTE 5:]How the local MCData system routes the SIP request through an exit MCData gateway server is out of the scope of the present document. shall include the public service identity of the controlling MCData function in the P-Asserted-Identity header field; and shall include a P-Asserted-Service header field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd".
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Network-triggered notifications for FD > Controlling MCData function procedures > Expiry of timer TDC2 (file availability timer)
Content: When timer TDC2 (file availability timer) associated to a specific Conversation ID and Message ID expires, the controlling MCData function shall identify a target set of MCData client(s) as being: the MCData client that received a one-to-one file distribution using HTTP for the associated Conversation ID and Message ID, but has not yet downloaded the file; or each MCData client that received a group standalone file distribution using HTTP for the associated Conversation ID and Message ID, but have not yet downloaded the file; On expiry of timer TDC2 (file availability timer), for each identified MCData client, the controlling MCData function: NOTE: The file availability timer is associated to the Conversation ID and Message ID that was present in the initial FD request. shall generate a SIP MESSAGE request as specified in clause 12.4.2.1; shall include an FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body of the SIP MESSAGE request with: [ a) ] the FD notification type IE as "FILE EXPIRED UNAVAILABLE TO DOWNLOAD" as specified in clause 15.2.6; shall set the Date and time IE to the current time as specified in clause 15.2.8; the Conversation ID IE set to a value identifying the conversation, as specified in clause 15.2.9; the Message ID IE set to a value identifying the message as specified in clause 15.2.10; if an Application ID was stored against the expired timer TDC2 (file availability timer), shall set the Application ID to the stored value as specified in clause 15.2.7; if an Extended application ID was stored against the expired timer TDC2 (file availability timer), shall set the Extended application ID to the stored value as specified in clause 15.2.7; and shall send the SIP MESSAGE request according to according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 .
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Network-triggered notifications for FD > Participating MCData function procedures
Content: The participating MCData function shall follow the procedures in clause 10.2.4.3.2.
Title Path: Dispositions and Notifications > Network-triggered notifications for FD > MCData client terminating procedures
Content: On receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body with a FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message, the MCData client: may reject the SIP MESSAGE request if there are not enough resources to handle the SIP MESSAGE request; if the SIP MESSAGE request is rejected in step 1), shall respond towards the participating MCData function with a SIP 480 (Temporarily unavailable) response and skip the rest of the steps of this clause; shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send the SIP 200 (OK) response towards the MCData server according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall decode the contents of the FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message contained in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; if the FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message contains an Application ID or contains an Extended application ID, shall deliver the FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message to the application; and if the FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message does not contain an Application ID and does not contain an Extended application ID, shall deliver the FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message to the user.
Title Path: Communication Release > General
Content: Communication Release allows MCData user or MCData server to release MCData communications on-demand or based on policies. These procedures are applicable for SDS and FD and can be initiated by communication originator or MCData server.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > General > Server generating message for release of communication over HTTP towards participating MCData function
Content: This procedure is only referenced from other procedures. In order to generate a SIP MESSAGE towards the participating MCData function, the MCData server: shall generate SIP MESSAGE accordance with 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 3428 ; shall include an Accept-Contact header field with the media feature tag g.3gpp.icsi-ref with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" along with parameters "require" and "explicit" according to IETF RFC 3841 in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; shall include a P-Asserted-Service header field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd"; shall set the Request-URI of the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request to the public service identity of the participating MCData function associated to the originating MCData ID user; and shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body in the SIP MESSAGE request , following the rules specified in clause 6.4 for the handling of MIME bodies in a SIP message: [ a) ] fill mcdata-request-uri element with the MCData ID of the target user. shall include FD HTTP TERMINATION in application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling. While generating an FD HTTP TERMINATION message as specified in clause 15.1.3.1, the MCData server: shall set the Conversation ID IE to a value identifying the conversation, as specified in clause 15.2.9 shall set the Message ID IE to a value identifying the message as specified in clause 15.2.10; may set: [ i) ] the Application ID IE to the stored value if applicable or the Extended application ID IE to the stored value if applicable; and shall include a Payload IE with: [ a) ] the Payload content type set to "FILEURL" as specified in clause 15.2.13 ; and Shall set the URL of the file same as of FD transmission.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > General > Authorised user generating FD HTTP TERMINATION MESSAGE towards participating MCData function
Content: This clause is referred from other clause only. In order to generate a SIP MESSAGE towards participating MCData function: Shall generate SIP MESSAGE accordance with 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 3428 ; shall include an Accept-Contact header field with the media feature tag g.3gpp.icsi-ref with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" along with parameters "require" and "explicit" according to IETF RFC 3841 in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request; shall include a P-preferred-Service header field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd"; shall set the Request-URI of the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request to the public service identity of the participating MCData function associated to the MCData ID user; and shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body in the SIP MESSAGE request , following the rules specified in clause 6.4 for the handling of MIME bodies in a SIP message: [ a) ] set mcdata-request-uri element to the MCData ID of the target user; and shall include FD HTTP TERMINATION application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling. While including FD HTTP TERMINATION message according to clause E.1. When generating an FD HTTP TERMINATION message as specified in clause 15.1.11, the MCData client: shall set the Conversation ID IE to a value identifying the conversation, as specified in clause 15.2.9; shall set the Message ID IE to a value identifying the message as specified in clause 15.2.10; may set: [ i) ] the Application ID IE ID to the stored value if applicable; or the Extended Application ID IE to the stored value if applicable; and shall include a Payload IE with: [ a) ] the Payload content type set to "FILEURL" as specified in clause 15.2.13 ; and the URL of the file same as of FD transmission.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > General
Content: The MCData client can release the communication to indicate MCData service that the user no longer wants to transmit.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > General
Content: The procedures described in this clause are applicable to MCData SDS and MCData FD using media plane where originating MCData user initiates the communication release.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > MCData client procedures > MCData client originating procedures
Content: When the MCData client wants to release a MCData communication established over the media plane, the MCData client: shall generate a SIP BYE request according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall set the Request-URI to the MCData session identity to be released; and shall send the SIP BYE request towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request, the MCData client shall release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication being released.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > MCData client procedures > MCData client terminating procedures
Content: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request, the MCData client: shall send SIP 200 (OK) response towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication being released. NOTE: Partially received data can be stored and processed.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Participating MCData function procedures > Originating participating MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request from the MCData client, the originating participating MCData function: shall generate a SIP BYE request as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall set the Request-URI to the MCData session identity mentioned in the received SIP BYE request; shall include a P-Asserted-Identity header field in the outgoing SIP BYE request set to the public service identity of the participating MCData function; and shall send the SIP BYE request toward the controlling MCData function, according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request the participating MCData function; shall forward the SIP 200 (OK) response to the originating MCData client and release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication with the originating MCData client; and shall release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication with the controlling MCData function.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Participating MCData function procedures > Terminating participating MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request from the controlling MCData function, the participating MCData function: shall generate a SIP BYE request according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall include a P-Asserted-Identity header field in the outgoing SIP BYE request set to the public service identity of the participating MCData function; and shall send the SIP BYE request to the MCData client according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request the participating MCData function: shall send the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request received from the controlling MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 and release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication with the controlling MCData function; and shall release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication with the terminating MCData client.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Controlling MCData function procedures > Communication release policy for group MCData communication
Content: T he controlling MCData function shall release the group MCData communication, i f: the controlling MCData function receives an indication from the media plane that the transmission time limit has reached; the controlling MCData function receives an indication from the media plane that the transmission data limit per request has reached; there are only one or no participants in the MCData communication; according to a local policy, the initiator of the group call leaves the MCData communication; or the minimum number of affiliated MCData group members is not present;
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Controlling MCData function procedures > Communication release policy for one-to-one MCData communication
Content: The controlling MCData function shall release the one-to-one MCData communication if: the controlling MCData function receives an indication from the media plane that the transmission time limit has reached; the controlling MCData function receives an indication from the media plane that the transmission data limit per request has reached; or there are only one or no participants in the MCData communication.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Controlling MCData function procedures > Receiving a SIP BYE request
Content: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request the controlling MCData function: shall release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication with the originating participating MCData function; shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response and send the SIP response towards the originating MCData client according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall check the communication release policy as specified in clause 13.2.2.2.4.1 and clause 13.2.2.2.4.2 whether the MCData communication needs to be released for each participant of the MCData communication; and if release of the MCData communication is required, perform the procedures as specified in the clause 13.2.2.2.4.4.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Controlling MCData function procedures > Sending a SIP BYE request
Content: When a participant needs to be removed from the MCData communication, the controlling MCData function: shall interact with the media plane as specified in 3GPP TS 24.582 for the MCData communication release; shall generate a SIP BYE request according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall send the SIP BYE request to the MCData client according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . If group MCData communication needs to be released, the controlling MCData function shall send SIP BYE requests as described in this clause to all the participants of the communication. Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to a SIP BYE request, the controlling MCData function shall release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication with the terminating participating MCData function.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > General
Content: The procedures described in this clause are applicable to MCData FD using HTTP where originating MCData user initiates the communication release. This procedure applicable after file upload happened successfully and originating client sends SDS message towards server.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > MCData client procedures > MCData client originating procedures > Initiating Release
Content: When MCData client wants to release MCData communication either one-to-one FD or group-FD established over HTTP, the MCData client shall generate a SIP MESSAGE request in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 3428 with the clarifications given below. The MCData client: shall build the SIP MESSAGE request as specified in clause 6.2.4.1; if terminating one-to-one FD transmission, shall insert in the SIP MESSAGE request: [ a) ] an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body with the MCData ID of the recipient of FD transmission in the "uri" attribute of the entry element of the list element of the resource-lists element of the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body, according to rules and procedures of IETF RFC 4826 ; and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with a request-type element set to a value of "one-to-one-fd"; if terminating group FD transmission: [ a) ] shall insert in the SIP MESSAGE request an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with: [ i) ] the request-type element set to a value of "group-fd"; the mcdata-request-uri element set to the MCData group identity for which FD transmission happening; and the mcdata-client-id element set to the MCData client ID of the originating MCData client; shall generate a standalone FD message as specified in clause 6.2.2.4; and shall send the SIP MESSAGE request according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 towards originating particiapting function.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > MCData client procedures > MCData client originating procedures > Receiving Release Response Type from server
Content: Upon receiving SIP MESSAGE from server containing application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body with HTTP TERMINATION MESSAGE and FD signalling payload message identity value set as FD HTTP TERMINATION as described in clause 15.2.2 then shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send SIP 200 (OK) response towards participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; if FD HTTP TERMINATION message contains an Application ID or contains an Extended Application ID, shall deliver the FD HTTP TERMINATION message to the application; and if Termination information type IE in HTTP TERMINATION MESSAGE is set to "TERMINATION RESPONSE" as specified in clause 15.2.22 and If Release Response Type IE present then: [ a) ] set to "RELEASE SUCCESS" as described in clause 15.2.23 the notify user that termination request is successful; or set to "RELEASE FAILED" as described in clause 15.2.23 then notify user that termination request failed.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > MCData client procedures > MCData client terminating procedures
Content: On receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body with a FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message, the MCData client shall follow the procedure as described in clause 12.4.4.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Participating MCData function procedures > Originating participating MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receipt of a "SIP MESSAGE request for FD using HTTP for originating participating MCData function", the participating MCData function should follow the procedure as describe in clause 10.2.4.3.1.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Participating MCData function procedures > Terminating participating MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receipt of a "SIP MESSAGE request for FD using HTTP for terminating participating MCData function", the participating MCData function should follow the procedure as describe in clause 10.2.4.3.2.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData originating user initiated communication release > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Controlling MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receipt of a "SIP MESSAGE request for FD using HTTP for controlling MCData function", the controlling MCData function should follow the procedure as describe in clause 10.2.4.4.2.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > General
Content: Based on local policies and conditions explained in clause 13.2.2.2.4.1 and clause 13.2.2.2.4.2, MCData server can release an ongoing MCData communication. Based on the configuration, MCData server can decide to release the communication without prior notification to MCData client.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over media plane > General
Content: The procedures described in this clause are applicable to MCData SDS and MCData FD using media plane where MCData server initiates communication release.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over media plane > MCData client procedures
Content: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request from the MCData server, the MCData client should follow the procedure described in clause 13.2.2.2.2 .2 with following clarification: 1) shall notify the MCData user with reason for release of communication if SIP BYE request contains reason header.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Participating MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receiving SIP BYE request from controlling MCData function, the participating MCData function should follow the procedure described in clause 13.2.2.2.3 .2 with following clarification: 1) if reason header is present in the incoming SIP BYE request, shall copy the contents of the reason header field of the incoming SIP BYE request to the reason header field of the outgoing SIP BYE request.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Controlling MCData function procedures
Content: Based on communication release policies and configuration, when controlling MCData function wants to release communication, the controlling MCData function should follow the procedure as described in clause 13.2.2.2.4.4 with following clarification: 1) shall add reason header with reason-text value as appropriate (e.g. data volume limit, time limit expiry).
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > General
Content: This procedure described in this clause are applicable to MCData FD using HTTP where MCData server initiates communication release.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > MCData client procedures > MCData client originating procedure
Content: Upon receiving SIP MESSAGE from MCData server containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body, the MCData client: shall decode the contents of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; if application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains a FD HTTP TERMINATION message as specified in clause 15.1.11 and if the Termination Information Type IE is set to "TRANSMISSION STOPPED", then: [ a) ] shall generate a SIP 200 OK response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall send the SIP 200 (OK) response towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall notify MCData user about file transmission being stopped by identifying the corresponding file transmission local database based on conversation id, message id and FILE URL received in FD HTTP TERMINATION message, along with reason.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > MCData client procedures > MCData client terminating procedure
Content: On receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body with a FD NETWORK NOTIFICATION message, the MCData client shall follow the procedures as described in clause 12.4.4.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Participating MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receipt of a "SIP MESSAGE request for FD using HTTP for terminating participating MCData function", the participating MCData function shall follow the procedure as described in clause 10.2.4.3.2.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Controlling MCData function procedures
Content: Base on communication release policies and configuration, when controlling MCData function wants to release communication, the controlling MCData function: shall execute procedure as described in clause 12.4.2.1 to delete the file and notify to participants with following clarification: [ a) ] shall set FD notification type IE as "FILE DELETED UNAVAILABLE TO DOWNLOAD" as specified in clause 15.2.18; and shall generate SIP MESSAGE as described in clause 13.2.1.1 and [ a) ] shall add reason header with reason-text value as appropriate (e.g. data volume limit, time limit expiry); shall set Termination information type IE of FD HTTP TERMINATION MESSAGE to "TRANSMISSION STOPPED" as described in clause 15.2.22; and shall send the SIP MESSAGE to MCData user who initiated the communication according to according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 .
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > General
Content: Based on local policies and conditions as mentioned in clause 13.2.2.2.4.1 and clause 13.2.2.2.4.2, the MCData server can release an ongoing MCData communication. If configured to, the MCData server can notify the originating MCData user about the intent to release communication and may request for more data about the communication it intends to release. The procedures described in this clause are applicable to MCData SDS and MCData FD using media plane where the MCData server initiates the communication release.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > MCData client procedures for communication over media plane > Receiving intent to release the communication
Content: Upon receiving a SIP INFO request within the SIP dialog of a MCData communication, with the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release package and containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body associated with the Info-Package, t he MCData client: shall decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; if the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message as specified in clause 15.1.10, with the Comm release information type IE set to " INTENT TO RELEASE", then: [ a) ] shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send SIP 200 (OK) response towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and if an Data query type IE is present and set to "REMAINING AMOUNT OF DATA", then: [ i) ] shall generate a DATA PAYLOAD message as described in clause 15.1.4; shall generate a SIP INFO request according to 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 6086 ; shall include in the SIP INFO request, the DATA PAYLOAD message in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload MIME body as specified in clause E.2; and [ A) ] shall set a Content-Disposition header field to "Info-Package" value; and shall send the SIP INFO request within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, towards the participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall notify MCData user and present the reason, if the reason header is present in incoming SIP INFO message. When generating an DATA PAYLOAD message as specified in clause 15.1.4, the MCData client: shall set the Number of payloads IE to 1: [ a) ] shall set the Payload content type as "TEXT" as specified in clause 15.2.13; and shall include the remaining amount of data in bytes to be sent in the Payload data. Once the MCData user is notified about the MCData server's intent to release the communication, the MCData user may request for extension of communication as described in clause 13.2.4.2.2.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > MCData client procedures for communication over media plane > Request for extension of communication
Content: Upon receiving a request from MCData user for extension of the communication as a result of MCData server's intent to release the communication, the MCData client: shall generate a SIP INFO request according to 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 6086 ; shall include a Info-Package with header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release; shall include in the SIP INFO request, a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message as specified in clause 15.1.10, in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body as specified in clause E.1; and [ a) ] shall set a Content-Disposition header field to "Info-Package" value; and shall send the SIP INFO request within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, towards the participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . When generating an COMMUNICATION RELEASE message as specified in clause 15.1.10, the MCData client: 1) shall set the Comm release information type to "EXTENSION REQUEST".
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > MCData client procedures for communication over media plane > Receiving response to communication extension request
Content: Upon receiving a SIP INFO request within the SIP dialog of a MCData communication, with the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release package and containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body associated with the Info-Package, t he MCData client: shall decode the contents of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; and if the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message as specified in clause 15.1.10, with the Comm release information type IE set to " EXTENSION RESPONSE", then: [ a) ] shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send SIP 200 (OK) response towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall notify user about extension response based on Extension Response Type IE.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Participating MCData function procedures for communication over media plane > Receiving SIP INFO request from the controlling MCData function
Content: Upon receiving a SIP INFO request with the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release package, from controlling MCData function within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, the participating MCData function: shall generate a SIP INFO request according to 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 6086 ; shall copy the contents of the Info-Package header field of the incoming SIP INFO request to the Info-Package header field of the outgoing SIP INFO request; shall copy the MIME bodies present in the incoming SIP INFO request to the outgoing SIP INFO request; and shall send the SIP INFO request to the MCData client within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response from MCData client to the SIP INFO request, the participating MCData function: shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INFO request received from the controlling MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 .
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Participating MCData function procedures for communication over media plane > Receiving SIP INFO request from the MCData client
Content: Upon receiving a SIP INFO request with the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release package, from MCData client within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, t he participating MCData function: shall generate a SIP INFO request according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 6086 ; shall copy the contents of the Info-Package header field of the incoming SIP INFO request to the Info-Package header field of the outgoing SIP INFO request; shall copy the MIME bodies present in the incoming SIP INFO request to the outgoing SIP INFO request; and shall send the SIP INFO request to the controlling MCData function, within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response from controlling MCData function to the SIP INFO request, the participating MCData function: shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INFO request received from the MC Data client according to 3GPP TS 24.229 .
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Controlling MCData function procedures for communication over media plane > Sending intent to release a communication
Content: To send an intent to release a MCData communication, the controlling MCData function: shall generate a SIP INFO request according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 6086 ; shall include the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release; shall include in the SIP INFO request, a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body as specified in clause E.1: [ a) ] shall set a Content-Disposition header field to "Info-Package" value; may add reason header with reason-text value as appropriate (e.g. data volume limit, time limit expiry); and shall send a SIP request towards participating MCData function within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . When generating a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message, the controlling MCData function: shall generate a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message as defined in clause 15.1.10. In the COMMUNICATION RELEASE message, the controlling MCData function: [ a) ] shall set Comm Release Information type IE to "INTENT TO RELEASE"; and if requesting for more information, shall include and set Data query type IE to the " REMAINING AMOUNT OF DATA". Upon receiving SIP 200 OK, the controlling MCData function: 1) shall start Timer TDC3 (request for extension). If timer TDC3 (request for extension) expires before controlling MCData function receives a request for extension of communication from the MCData client, the controlling MCData function shall release MCData communication as described in clause 13.2.2.2.4.4.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Controlling MCData function procedures for communication over media plane > Receiving more information
Content: Upon receiving a SIP INFO request within the SIP dialog of a MCData communication, with the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release package and containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload MIME body associated with the Info-Package, t he controlling MCData function: shall decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload MIME body; and shall identify the number of Payload IEs in the DATA PAYLOAD message from the Number of payloads IE in the DATA PAYLOAD message: [ a) ] For each Payload IE: [ i) ] shall store the contents of the Payload IE as remaining data information associated with ongoing MCData communication;
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Controlling MCData function procedures for communication over media plane > Receiving request for extension of communication
Content: Upon receiving a SIP INFO request within the SIP dialog of a MCData communication, with the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release package and containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body associated with the Info-Package, t he controlling MCData function: shall decode the contents of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; and if application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains COMMUNICATION RELEASE message with the comm release information type IE set to " EXTENSION REQUEST", the controlling MCData function: [ a) ] shall stop the timer TDC3 (request for extension); shall generate SIP 200 (OK) response and send it towards participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall send response to communication extension request as described in clause 13.2.4.4.4.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Controlling MCData function procedures for communication over media plane > Sending response to communication extension request
Content: To send a response to communication extension request from MCData client, the controlling MCData function: shall generate a SIP INFO request according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 6086 ; shall include the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release ; shall include in the SIP INFO request, a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body as specified in clause E.1; and [ a) ] Shall set a Content-Disposition header field to "Info-Package" value; and shall send a SIP request towards participating MCData function within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . When generating a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message, the controlling MCData function: Shall generate a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message as defined in clause 15.1.10. In the COMMUNICATION RELEASE message, the controlling MCData function: [ a) ] Shall set Comm Release Information type IE to "EXTENSION RESPONSE"; and shall assert the local policy along with already stored remaining data information associated with the MCData communication: [ i) ] If controlling MCData function decides to accept the request for extension, shall set extension request type information element to "ACCEPTED"; or If controlling MCData function, decides to reject the request for extension, shall set extension request type information element to "REJECTED"; Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response, 1) shall release the MCData communication as described in clause 13.2.2.2.4.4, if controlling MCData function, decides to reject the request for extension.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > General
Content: Based on communication release policies and configuration , the MCData server can release an ongoing MCData communication. If configured, the MCData server can notify the originating MCData user about the intent to release communication and may request for more data about the communication it intends to release. The procedures described in this clause are applicable to MCData FD using HTTP where the MCData server initiates the communication release.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > MCData client procedures > Receiving intent to release the communication
Content: Upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request containing an application/ vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; the MCData client: shall decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; if the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains a FD HTTP TERMINATION message as specified in clause 15.1.11, with the Termination information type IE set to " INTENT TO RELEASE COMM OVER HTTP " then: [ a) ] shall identify file transmission request with Conversation ID, Message ID, and FILE URL in FD HTTP TERMINATION message, if identified any transmission: [ i) ] shall generate SIP 200 (OK) according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send SIP 200 (OK) response towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall store the public service identity of the controlling MCData function from mcdata-controller-psi element of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body ; and shall notify MCData user and present the reason; if the reason header is present in SIP MESSAGE. Once the MCData user is notified about the MCData server's intent to release the communication, the MCData user may request for extension of communication as described in clause 13.2.4.5.2.2
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > MCData client procedures > Request for extension of communication
Content: Upon receiving a request from MCData user for extension of the communication as a result of MCData server's intent to release the communication, the MCData client: shall generate SIP MESSAGE request according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall generated a standalone FD message as specified in clause 6.2.2.4 with following clarifications: [ a) ] shall set Termination information type IE to "EXTENSION REQUEST FOR COMM OVER HTTP"; shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body: [ a) ] shall set mcdata-controller-psi element to the store public service identity of controlling MCData function; and shall send the SIP MESSAGE request according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 towards originating participating function.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > MCData client procedures > Receiving response to communication extension request
Content: Upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request from MCData server containing application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body, the MCData client: shall decode the contents of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; and if the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains a FD HTTP TERMINATION message as specified in clause 15.1.11, with the Termination information type IE set to "EXTENSION RESPONSE FOR COMM OVER HTTP", then: [ a) ] shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send SIP 200 (OK) response towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall notify user about extension response based on Extension response type IE.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Participating MCData function procedures > Originating participating MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receipt of a "SIP MESSAGE request for FD using HTTP for originating participating MCData function", the participating MCData function shall follow the procedure described in clause 10.2.4.3.1.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Participating MCData function procedures > Terminating participating MCData function procedures
Content: Upon receipt of a "SIP MESSAGE network notification for FD using HTTP for terminating participating MCData function", the participating MCData function shall follow the procedure described in clause 10.2.4.3.2
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Controlling MCData function procedures > Sending intent to release a communication
Content: To send an intent to release a MCData communication, the controlling MCData function: shall generate a SIP MESSAGE as described in clause 13.2.1.1; shall include mcdata-controller-psi element in application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with public service identity of controlling function; shall set Termination information type IE in FD HTTP TERMINATION of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body to " INTENT TO RELEASE COMM OVER HTTP"; may add reason header with reason-text value as appropriate (e.g. data volume limit, time limit expiry); and shall send a SIP request towards participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . Upon receiving SIP 200 OK, the controlling MCData function: 1) shall start Timer TDC3 (request for extension). If timer TDC3 (request for extension) expires before controlling MCData function receives a request for extension of communication from the MCData client, the controlling MCData function shall release MCData communication as described in clause 13.2.3.3.4.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Controlling MCData function procedures > Receiving request for extension of communication
Content: Upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request, the controlling MCData function: shall decode the contents of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; and if application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains FD HTTP TERMINATION message with the Termination information type IE set to " EXTENSION REQUEST FOR COMM OVER HTTP " , the controlling MCData function: [ a) ] shall stop the timer TDC3 (request for extension) for file transmission identified by Conversation ID and Message ID and FILE URL; shall generate SIP 200 (OK) response and send it towards participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall send response to communication extension request as described in clause 13.2.4.5.4.3.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > MCData server initiated communication release with prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Controlling MCData function procedures > Sending response to communication extension request
Content: To send a response to communication extension request from MCData client, the controlling MCData function: shall generate a SIP MESSAGE as described in clause 13.2.1.1; shall set Termination information type IE in FD HTTP TERMINATION of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body to " EXTENSION RESPONSE FOR COMM OVER HTTP"; shall assert the local policy associated with the MCData communication: [ a) ] If controlling MCData function decides to accept the request for extension, shall set Extension response type IE to "ACCEPTED"; or If controlling MCData function, decides to reject the request for extension, shall set Extension response type IE to "REJECTED"; and shall send SIP MESSAGE towards participating MCData function according 3GPP TS 24.229 ; Upon receiving 200 OK response: 1) shall release the MCData communication as described in clause 13.2.3.3.4; if controlling MCData function decides to reject the request for extension.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > General
Content: An authorized MCData user at any point of time during an ongoing MCData communication decides to release communication. An authorized MCData user should be part of the ongoing MCData communication. The procedure in this clause describes the case where an authorized MCData user decides to release the communication without providing prior indication to originator MCData user.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over media plane > General
Content: The procedures described in this clause are applicable to MCData SDS and MCData FD established using media plane.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Authorized MCData client procedures > Sending communication release request
Content: Upon receiving request from an authorized MCData user to release the communication without prior indication to originating MCData user, the MCData client: shall generate a SIP INFO request according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 6086 ; shall include the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release; shall include in the SIP INFO request, a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body as specified in clause E.1: [ a) ] shall set a Content-Disposition header field to "Info-Package" value; shall insert in the SIP INFO request an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with [ a) ] the mcdata-client-id element set to the MCData client ID of the authorized MCData client; may add reason header with reason-text value as appropriate; and shall send a SIP request towards participating MCData function within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, according to 3GPP TS 24.229 . When generating a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message, the MCData client : shall generate a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message as defined in clause 15.1.10. In the COMMUNICATION RELEASE message, the MCData client : [ a) ] shall set Comm Release Information type IE to " AUTH USER RELEASE REQ ". Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response from participating MCData function to the SIP INFO request, the MCData client should inform the authorized MCData user about acceptance of communication release request by MCData server. Upon receiving a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response from participating MCData function to the SIP INFO request, the MCData client should inform the authorized MCData user about rejection of communication release request by MCData server.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Participating MCData function procedures > Receiving SIP INFO request from the authorized MCData client
Content: Upon receiving a SIP INFO request with the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release package, from MCData client within the SIP dialog of the MCData communication, t he participating MCData function should follow the procedure described in clause 13.2.4.3.2. Upon receiving a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response from controlling MCData function to the SIP INFO request, the participating MCData function: shall generate a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the SIP INFO request received from the MC Data client according to 3GPP TS 24.229 .
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over media plane > Controlling MCData function procedures > Receiving request to release the communication from authorized MCData user
Content: Upon receiving a SIP INFO request within the SIP dialog of a MCData communication, with the Info-Package header field set to g.3gpp.mcdata-com-release package and containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body associated with the Info-Package, the controlling MCData function: shall decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; if the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message as specified in clause 15.1.10, with the Comm release information type IE set to " AUTH USER RELEASE REQ " , then: [ a) ] shall validate whether MCData user from which communication release request is received is authorized or not based on configuration; if MCData user validation is not successful, [ a) ] shall generate a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send SIP 403 (Forbidden) response towards participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall skip further steps; if MCData user validation is successful, [ a) ] shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send SIP 200 (OK) response towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall follow the procedure as described in clause 13.2.3.2.4 to terminate the ongoing communication;
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > General
Content: The procedures described in this clause are applicable to MCData FD over HTTP.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Authorized MCData client procedures > Sending communication release request
Content: Upon receiving request from an authorized MCData user to release the communication without prior indication to originating MCData user, the MCData client shall generate a SIP MESSAGE as specified in clause 13.2.1.2, then: [ a) ] shall set the Termination information type IE if FD HTTP TERMINATION message to " AUTH USER TERMINATION REQUEST FOR COMM OVER HTTP " as specified in clause 15.2.22; shall add application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body in SIP MESSAGE with: [ a) ] shall set mcdata-controller-psi element to the value received in incoming SIP MESSAGE; and shall add mcdata-client-id element set to the MCData client ID of the authorized MCData client; may add reason header with reason-text value as appropriate; and shall send the SIP MESSAGE request according to rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 towards originating participating function. Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response from participating MCData function to the SIP MESSAGE request, the MCData client should inform the authorized MCData user about acceptance of communication release request by MCData server. Upon receiving a SIP 403 (Forbidden) or SIP 404 (Not found) response from participating MCData function to the SIP MESSAGE request, the MCData client should inform the authorized MCData user about rejection of communication release request by MCData server.
Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Authorized MCData client procedures > Receiving Release Response Type from server

Title Path: Communication Release > On-network > Authorized MCData user initiated communication release without prior indication > Release of MCData communication over HTTP > Controlling MCData function procedures > Receiving request to release the communication from authorized MCData user
Content: Upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request and containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body, the controlling MCData function: shall decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body; if the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body contains FD HTTP TERMINATION message as specified in clause 15.1.11 then: [ a) ] if Termination information type IE set to "AUTH USER TERMINATION REQUEST FOR COMM OVER HTTP", then: [ i) ] shall validate whether MCData user identified in mcdata-calling-userid element of application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml, is authorized or not based on configuration; if MCData user validation is not successful: [ i) ] shall generate a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; shall send SIP 403 (Forbidden) response towards participating MCData function according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall skip further steps; if MCData user validation is successful: [ i) ]if not able to identify file transmission using the Conversation ID, Message ID and file URL, shall send SIP 404 (Not Found) with reason with waring text set to "224 No transmission available" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.9, and shall not continue with the rest of the steps; [ii)]shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and [ii)]shall send SIP 200 (OK) response towards MCData server according to 3GPP TS 24.229 ; and shall follow the procedure as described in clause 13.2.3.3.4 to terminate the ongoing communication.
